recommendations: **Choose the M3 prop first; it matters more than the M2 prop.** Across the 8S enumeration the mean F runs from 5.9430 to 5.9760 with the M3 prop (22x12E best), and only from 5.9557 to 5.9584 with the M2 prop. *Rests on §5.1. Confidence: medium; the ordering comes from the cited APC data, but the model flies M3 laps too fast (§7), so the size of the gain isn't a prediction.*

**Carry more passengers than Humpback's 42, and test the fuselage it takes.** Every normalisation tried wants at least 53 passengers, so the direction doesn't rest on the PLACEHOLDER normalisers (Q52), though the MDO's own count does. *Rests on §5.1 and §5.2. Confidence: medium for the direction, low for the count; the Ground Mission, which grows with the counts, isn't modelled (Q53), and a fuselage this long is an extrapolation of the mass calibration (§7).*

**Don't size the banner to its limit before its drag is known.** RDO gives up banner length (275 to 228 in) for margin: sigma of F 0.1175 to 0.0833, P(any violation) 0.071 to 0.000, at 0.0413 of nominal F. The re-analyses at [HB] Table 41's drag coefficients show why (§5.4). *Rests on §4 and §5.4. Confidence: medium; the Monte Carlo favours RDO by construction, so read it with §2.5's out-of-set result.*

**Spend ground and flight tests on banner drag and built mass.** They are the largest contributions to the sigma of F with measured spreads: banner drag factor 0.0375 ([HB] Table 41), build factor 0.0292 (USYD leave-one-out). Wind contributes more, but its spread is a PLACEHOLDER and it can't be designed out by a test. *Rests on §4's screening. Confidence: medium.*

**Don't commission a motor rewind for this score.** At the best prop pair, every converged start reaches the same F with Kv anywhere from 220 to 245 rpm/V: a flat direction, inside which the throttle takes up the difference. *Rests on §5.1's multistart. Confidence: medium; the motor's limits are checked, but its thermal behaviour isn't modelled.*

**Use the rule limits on span and M3 energy.** The optima sit on the 5 ft span (b 1.524 m, Humpback 1.499 m) and the 100 Wh limit in M3, both from the rules [R26 p. 10, p. 16], not from a PLACEHOLDER. *Rests on §3's active-constraint table. Confidence: high that they're active in the model, medium on the gain, which isn't separated from the others.*

**Log M3 lap times and throttle in test flights, with the banner's size.** The largest gap between this model and Humpback is M3's lap time, and these logs are what closes it. *Rests on validation_2026.md and §7's first row. Confidence: high that the gap exists, its cause isn't separated (Q56, Q57).*
findings: **Best propulsion case: 8S_19x12E_22x12E.** After payload rounding (MDO): F = 5.9775 capped, 5.9806 uncapped, 5.8588 floored, with M2 1.9998, M3 2.9777, 72 passengers, 24 cargo, a 275 in banner.
The enumeration's spread is 0.0607 in F over 10 converged cases (8S_19x12E_22x12E first, 6S_19x12E_22x12E_kv270 last); 1 did not converge.

**Against Humpback as built (5.2845 in the same model):** MDO gains +0.6930, through payload (42/14 to 72/24) and banner (197 to 275 in). The common evaluation is AirCrafter 2.0's own model, so it favours this; and the Ground Mission, which grows with the counts, isn't in F (Q53).

**Against AirCrafter 1.0's selection in the same model:** direct (a) 5.4883, completed (b) 5.6579, MDO 5.9775: +0.3196 over (b), the like-for-like comparison (the same model, optimised around AirCrafter 1.0's span, chord, counts and banner).

**What robustness costs.** Nominal F: -0.0057 from designing at the mean wind, -0.0357 from robustness itself. Monte Carlo mean: +0.0061 and -0.0007. Sigma: 0.1175 (MDO) to 0.0833 (RDO). P(any violation): 0.071 to 0.137 to 0.000. RDO's gain is in variance and feasibility, not the mean: 73 of 1024 MDO samples sit on the sub-stall balance, and without them MDO's mean is 5.8785 against RDO's 5.8737. On the floored score (completed laps, hard cap) the order reverses: RDO 5.9120, MDO 5.8588.

**Multistart (10 Sobol' starts):** 6 converge feasibly, to 1 distinct optimum/optima (F within 0.001): F 5.9775–5.9775 (6). The default start's F is 5.9775. The others: ms1: MDA non-convergence: Solver 'NL: Newton' on system 'points.M2.mda' fai; ms2: MDA non-convergence: Solver 'NL: Newton' on system 'points.M2.mda': re; ms5: MDA non-convergence: Solver 'NL: Newton' on system 'points.M2.mda': re; ms6: MDA non-convergence: Solver 'NL: Newton' on system 'points.M2.mda': re.

**The bound-driven part.** (i) c <= 0.60 m and camber_scale <= 2.5: ΔF +0.0198. (ii) V_h >= 0.50, V_v >= 0.04 (Raymer 6th ed., Table 6.4, p. 160, homebuilt): ΔF -0.0108. (iii) V_h >= 0.66 ([OH]), V_v >= 0.059 ([W]), the lowest flown: ΔF -0.0211. (added) banner <= 500 in, AirCrafter 1.0's grid limit ([HB] Table 7), against the 275 in the team built (Q56): ΔF +0.0008.
**Propagation at the robust optimum:** mean of F 5.8751 (UDR), 5.8740 (Smolyak), 5.8737 (Sobol'); sigma 0.0836, 0.0849, 0.0833.

**Analysis failures are counted apart from violations:** in-set Monte Carlo, MDA failures / lap-model limits out of N: Humpback 0 / 0 of 1024; MDO 0 / 0 of 1024; MDO, mean wind 0 / 0 of 1024; MDO + RDO 0 / 0 of 1024. A first run lost 17-30 % of its samples to a worker failure, not to the design (RESULTS_LOG.md, Decision 13), and was replaced.

**Banner drag at fixed throttle:** across the 4 C_D,b values re-analysed, MDO loses level flight or a constraint at 3 and RDO at 0 (§5.4). MDO's limit on the placeholder banner bound leaves it no margin on M3's low-speed balance.

**Where this differs from 2024-25 (Appendix A).** There the multipoint gain over the as-built aircraft was small (Woombah 5.1020, MDO 5.0993) and the optimum was tank-limited on M2; here MDO is +0.6930 over Humpback, and M2 sits at the score's cap, so the cap and the fuselage's payload law set the payload. There robustness cost 0.0007 in nominal F and took the largest P(violation) from 0.621 to 0.016; here it costs 0.0413 and takes P(any) from 0.071 to 0.000.
limitations: Lap errors (model minus test, negative = model too fast): M3 test1 -46 %, M3 test2 -31 %, M3 test3 -20 %, M2 test1 -23 %, M2 test2 -15 %. Deployed C_D0 0.243 at the 197 in test against Table 29's 0.36.
Tail volumes at their PLACEHOLDER minimums; no directional-stability or crosswind check

Humpback V_h 0.795, V_v 0.078; AC1 direct (a) V_h 0.575, V_v 0.050; AC1 completed (b) V_h 0.350, V_v 0.020; MDO V_h 0.350, V_v 0.020; MDO, mean wind V_h 0.350, V_v 0.020; MDO + RDO V_h 0.350, V_v 0.020. Raymer's typical values cost ΔF -0.0108, the lowest flown -0.0211. Directional stability isn't checked: not measured.
Relaxing c to 0.60 m and camber_scale to 2.5 is worth ΔF +0.0198, NeuralFoil confidence 0.932.

Overlap, mass and M2 drag counted twice: Humpback 0.41 m, 100 g, 1.6 counts; AC1 direct (a) 0.44 m, 110 g, 1.8 counts; AC1 completed (b) 0.44 m, 110 g, 1.8 counts; MDO 0.69 m, 171 g, 2.3 counts; MDO, mean wind 0.68 m, 167 g, 2.2 counts; MDO + RDO 0.76 m, 188 g, 2.5 counts.

Not in F. Its loading time grows with the counts (Humpback 42/14; AC1 direct (a) 45/15; AC1 completed (b) 45/15; MDO 72/24; MDO, mean wind 72/24; MDO + RDO 75/25); USYD's GM was 0.01 ([RES26] 2026 DBF Competition Summary (USYD, rank 14)): size not measured.

The model's neutral point sits about 0.2 c aft of the teams' eCalc, so its SM isn't comparable to the reports' 10-20 %. Modelled SM M2/M3: Humpback 0.39/0.43; AC1 direct (a) 0.31/0.37; AC1 completed (b) 0.26/0.36; MDO 0.37/0.38; MDO, mean wind 0.40/0.40; MDO + RDO 0.32/0.36.
The rectangular wing against Humpback's end-plated wing

End-plates aren't modelled: every design's induced drag is the plain rectangular wing's (M3 induced drag Humpback 83 counts; AC1 direct (a) 205 counts; AC1 completed (b) 159 counts; MDO 458 counts; MDO, mean wind 389 counts; MDO + RDO 233 counts). Effect of end-plates not measured.
LOO structure errors -26 / +12 / +24 %; f_build's ±30 % gives sigma of F 0.0522 at MDO. A payload fuselage this long is an extrapolation: l_cb 1.70 m against Humpback's 0.99 m.
The constant gear and leakage drag areas
×0.5 to ×2 at MDO: gear F 5.9804 to 5.9551, leakage F 5.9799 to 5.9606.
Calm air in the deterministic optimum
MDO F 5.9775 in calm air, 5.9225 at the mean wind; designing at the mean wind changes the Monte Carlo mean by +0.0061.
Fixed-throttle analysis can land on the sub-stall balance
73 of 1024 in-set samples of MDO have M3's level speed below 1.2 V_stall at its fixed throttle. They count as stall-margin violations. Without them the mean of F is 5.8785 against 5.8683.
